description.value: Name one firearm as your Iron, the way an Ironsight does, and become trained in it — advanced firearms and crossbows included. When that one weapon suffers a Gun Failure you roll a d6 rather than a d8. You do not get the rest of Nothing Dies in Your Hands: the bottom two results still find you, and they still find every other gun you pick up.

cinderfall.incomplete: Naming a firearm as your Iron and becoming trained in it is implemented (same ChoiceSet+MartialProficiency shape already used by this corpus's own Scrapwright 'One Gun, Many Grudges'). The d6-vs-d8 Gun Failure die override for that one weapon has no engine hook: Gun Failure is Cinderfall's own subsystem with no rule-element representation, so neither the die-size change nor withholding the rest of the real feat's benefit can be expressed.
